proposed_patch.text: Ensure that all preprocessing steps, such as scaling or transforming data, are performed within the training fold only. Avoid using any fields or data that will not be available at prediction time to prevent data leakage. Be cautious of validation scores that seem unusually high, as they may indicate a validation mirage due to improper data handling.

expected_effect: This patch is expected to reduce instances of validation mirage by reinforcing the importance of proper data handling and preprocessing within the training fold, thus preventing data leakage and improving the reliability of validation scores.
evidence: The memory indicates a lesson about fitting preprocessing steps inside the training fold only and being suspicious of overly good validation scores, which aligns with the detected failure mode of validation mirage.
Verifier results show preprocessing leakage and use of leaky fields, contributing to the validation mirage issue.
